svg.title: Historical document arms: unchanged references and provisional vector layout studies
svg.desc: This is an evidence comparison sheet containing three embedded original screenshots. It is not the path-only logo export. The study uses a generated-master arms conversion and modern font stand-ins; the reference engravings and historical typefaces have not been recreated or verified.
